ideas.title: Investigation into Minnesota autism program billing issues
ideas.description: This story would investigate the billing issues in Minnesota's autism program, including potential fraud and misuse of funds.
questions: What are the extent of the billing issues?
What actions are being taken to address the issues?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves potential misuse of funds meant for vulnerable populations. Investigating this issue could uncover larger patterns of fraud and abuse.

ideas.title: Analysis of Trump administration funding freezes
ideas.description: This story would analyze the Trump administration's funding freezes, including the blocked freeze for the Gateway Tunnel Project.
questions: What are the political motivations behind the funding freezes?
What are the implications for federal funding and infrastructure development?
ideas.insight: This story matters because it involves the use of executive power and potential abuse of authority. Investigating this issue could uncover larger patterns of politically motivated funding decisions.
